$$ A = \alpha v_1 v_1^T + \beta v_2 v_2^T $$
The eigenvalues of \(A\) are ___________.

$$ p(s) = s^4 + 5s^2 + 4 + K, $$
where \(K\) is an unknown real parameter. The complete range of \(K\) for which \(p(s)\) has all its roots on the imaginary axis is ________.

$$ G_1(s) = \frac{10}{s^2 + s + 1} \quad \text{and} \quad G_2(s) = \frac{10}{s^2 + s\sqrt{10} + 10} $$
have unit step responses \(y_1(t)\) and \(y_2(t)\), respectively. Which of the following statements is/are true?

options.text: \(y_1(t)\) and \(y_2(t)\) have the same percentage peak overshoot.
\(y_1(t)\) and \(y_2(t)\) have the same steady-state value.
